items.heading: Hemodialysis
steps: Call Lakeshore Community Health Plan number on plan card to schedule rides
Ask DaVita Park Manor dialysis unit for an earlier chair time
Message DaVita Park Manor dialysis unit social worker for transport assistance and benefits coordination

items.heading: Renal diet
steps: Go to Manna Food Pantry Mondays 1:00-3:00 PM at 1230 S Millard Ave

items.heading: Weight and blood pressure log
steps: Keep doing your daily weight and blood pressure log on paper; bring it to each hemodialysis session.

closing: Contact your care team with any questions.
